title: Returning a training kit in two steps

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Class ended early. Can I return our practice kit? The receiver’s still paired with the trainer’s tablet.
turns.zh: 課提早結束。我可以還教學套件了嗎？接收器還和講師的平板配對著。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Put both practice buttons in the case and return it first. Leave the receiver with the trainer until she unpairs it.
turns.zh: 把兩個教學按鈕放進提箱，先還提箱。接收器留給講師，等她解除配對。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: She’s in at four. Won’t the kit look incomplete?
turns.zh: 她四點才會到。這樣套件看起來不是少了東西嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Put a note inside with the class code and receiver location. We’ll record a split return. Empty cases go on the open shelf. With items inside, use the counter by four thirty, or the locked cabinet by the office later.
turns.zh: 在提箱裡放張紙條，寫上課程代碼和接收器所在位置。我們會登記分批歸還。空箱放開放層架。有物品的箱子最晚四點半交到櫃檯；更晚就放辦公室旁的上鎖櫃。
